description: The page kinds that may declare `diataxis: none` (#7196). The ONE list read by scripts/check-diataxis-frontmatter.ts and cited by skills/diataxis/SKILL.md. A page matches a kind when its basename is in `basenames` (case-insensitive) or its repo-relative path starts with one of `pathPrefixes`. A page outside every kind must declare one of the four Diataxis types.

index.description: Index and landing pages that route readers to other pages.

adr.description: Architecture decision records: a dated decision, not a reader-facing document type.

research.description: Research notes and syntheses, kept as evidence rather than as user documentation.

archive.description: Archived pages kept for history and no longer maintained.
